note: Forbidden: a response that omits NAT_DETECTION_SOURCE_IP or NAT_DETECTION_DESTINATION_IP when the request carried them. internal/component/ike/engine/mobike_test.go::TestMobikePathProbeRetainsTunnelEndpoint (natDetection=true) requires exactly the two notifications, with hashes over the observed response tuple, so an omitted or reversed hash goes red. With natDetection=false it requires an empty response, so no hashes are sent unsolicited.
